---
title: "Ellwood Canyon Ranch"
format: html
---

Here is an interactive map that shows the most important parts of the ranch I work on.

Click on the different map locations to see photos and learn more about the ranch.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(leaflet)

# 1. Paste your published "Map Data" CSV link here
sheet_url <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vQG_5a3WJNqPAIQH6pgM2gvhQOV3j-HwBnEAd3MaTGcgYcRzkRNsQg-GWwy224MF7WoA7pivAGbr1zG/pub?gid=1300473115&single=true&output=csv"
ranch_data <- read_csv(sheet_url)

# 2. Overwrite exact locations with a safe, public central coordinate
safe_lat <- 34.4300  # Replace with a public landmark's latitude
safe_lng <- -119.8700 # Replace with a public landmark's longitude

ranch_data <- ranch_data %>% 
  mutate(
    lat = safe_lat,
    lng = safe_lng
  ) %>% 
  mutate(popup_content = paste0(
    "<div style='font-family: Arial, sans-serif; max-width: 220px;'>",
    "<h4 style='margin: 0 0 5px 0; color: #2E5A27;'>", title, "</h4>",
    "<p style='font-size: 13px; margin: 0 0 8px 0; line-height: 1.4;'>", description, "</p>",
    "<img src='", image, "' style='width: 100%; border-radius: 4px;'>",
    "</div>"
  ))

# 3. Build and center the map with marker clustering
leaflet(data = ranch_data) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$USGS.USImageryTopo) %>% 
  addMarkers(
    lng = ~lng, 
    lat = ~lat, 
    popup = ~popup_content, 
    label = ~title,
    # This line below fixes the stacking issue!
    clusterOptions = markerClusterOptions(spiderfyOnMaxZoom = TRUE)
  )
```
